object_records.name: extra_float_digits

object_records.name: fsync
object_records.short_desc: Forces synchronization of updates to disk.

object_records.name: full_page_writes
object_records.short_desc: Writes full pages to WAL when first modified after a checkpoint.
object_records.extra_desc: A page write in process during an operating system crash might be only partially written to disk.  During recovery, the row changes stored in WAL are not enough to recover.  This option writes pages when first modified after a checkpoint to WAL so full recovery is possible.
object_records.interpretation: Enabled; WAL page protection preserved.

object_records.name: geqo_generations

object_records.name: geqo_pool_size

object_records.name: ignore_checksum_failure
object_records.short_desc: Continues processing after a checksum failure.
object_records.extra_desc: Detection of a checksum failure normally causes PostgreSQL to report an error, aborting the current transaction. Setting ignore_checksum_failure to true causes the system to ignore the failure (but still report a warning), and continue processing. This behavior could cause crashes or other serious problems. Only has an effect if checksums are enabled.
object_records.interpretation: Privileged server setting; not by itself evidence of client privilege.

object_records.name: ignore_invalid_pages
object_records.short_desc: Continues recovery after an invalid pages failure.
object_records.extra_desc: Detection of WAL records having references to invalid pages during recovery causes PostgreSQL to raise a PANIC-level error, aborting the recovery. Setting "ignore_invalid_pages" to true causes the system to ignore invalid page references in WAL records (but still report a warning), and continue recovery. This behavior may cause crashes, data loss, propagate or hide corruption, or other serious problems. Only has an effect during recovery or in standby mode.
object_records.interpretation: Server-start parameter; changes require provider control and cannot be inferred from application migrations.

object_records.name: ignore_system_indexes
